piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Opinions with reasons and examples
texto: Contextual reading of a structured opinion essay: read the article reasoning about critical thinking and responsible media consumption. Notice how the author states a position, gives reasons, introduces a note of caution («อย่างไรก็ตาม») and closes with a practical educational proposal («ยกตัวอย่างเช่น»).

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การแยกแยะระหว่างข้อเท็จจริงและความคิดเห็นส่วนบุคคลเป็นทักษะการคิดเชิงวิพากษ์» express?

opciones.texto: Distinguishing verifiable facts from personal judgements is a hallmark of critical thinking.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การแยกแยะระหว่างข้อเท็จจริงและความคิดเห็นส่วนบุคคลเป็นทักษะการคิดเชิงวิพากษ์» from the text.

opciones.texto: Admitting the limits of your own thesis strengthens your credibility in debate.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Recapping the main points at the end emphasises your position with rigour.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: According to the essay read, why does the author consider it valuable to read news from multiple sources?

opciones.texto: Because it helps you understand multiple perspectives and objective facts (เห็นหลายมุมมอง)
opciones.explicacion: Correct: the first sentence argues «เพราะช่วยให้เห็นหลายมุมมองและเข้าใจข้อเท็จจริง».

opciones.texto: Because it lets you memorise newspapers faster
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: it is not about memorisation.

opciones.texto: Because it is a legal obligation in all schools
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: no legal requirement is mentioned.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.

opciones.texto: For example, a school can organise an exchange of opinions.
opciones.explicacion: The translation matches the Thai sentence.

opciones.texto: I think it is important to read news from several sources because it helps you see different perspectives.
opciones.explicacion: This is another sentence on the same topic.

opciones.texto: However, it is advisable to check the information before sharing it.
opciones.explicacion: This sentence expresses a different idea on the same topic.
